newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nord Pacific lifts copper production.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nord Pacific lifts copper production.

text.p: Nord Pacific Ltd said on Thursday total copper production at the Girilambone copper mining projects in New South Wales reached a record 4,654 tonnes during the fourth quarter of 1996, up 55 percent from the fourth quarter of 1995.
Average cash cost of production was US$0.37 per pound, 31 percent lower than in the previous quarter, the company said in its fourth quarter activities report.
Production in calendar 1996 was 16,281 tonnes, up 27 percent from full year 1995, the company said.
Nord Pacific said its share of production was 1,952 tonnes for the quarter and 6,573 tonnes for the full year.
This compares with 1,192 tonnes and 5,117 tonnes respectively in the corresponding periods a year earlier, figures show.

Nord Pacific holds a 40 percent stake the Girilambone mine. Straits Resources Ltd holds 60 percent. The nearby Girlilambone North mine is a 50-50 joint venture between Nord Pacific and Straits Resources.

"We attribute the production increase and lower costs to innovative leaching techniques recently implemented and believe production will continue at these higher levels for the foreseeable future," Nord Pacific's president Pierce Carson said in the report.
Sales prices declined to an average US$1.10 a pound in fourth quarter and US$1.12 per pound for the full year from US$1.20 and US$1.25 in the corresponding 1995 periods, Nord pacific said.
Nord Pacific is a subsidiary of Nord Resources Corp.
